shared_elements: shallow low-relief figure carved on an upright monolithic block
single dominant figure occupying most of the carved face
curved linear contour rendering of limbs/appendages
justification: Both surfaces carry a single large, schematically outlined figure in very shallow relief that fills the face of an upright block, and both use simple contour lines rather than modelled interior detail. But the subjects differ fundamentally: A is an anthropomorphic figure with head, arms folded over the torso, ornaments and a prominent disc, while B is a single quadruped in strict profile with an extended tail and no accompanying motifs or relationships between elements.
